plugins.name: chart
plugins.summary: open a chart of hledger's numbers in a window
plugins.help: Opens a chart in its own window, drawn from hledger's own numbers. Named questions answer for the usual cases: spending, income, cashflow, networth, balances, payees, top and shares. Others ask for the report their picture needs: stacked for spending by category over time, treemap for where the money went, sankey for income flowing into spending and savings, calendar for a year of daily spending, waterfall for income down to net, and multiples for a sparkline per account. Anything else is read as an account, and a report name such as balance or register is passed through verbatim. Hover or Tab to a mark for its numbers, click or Enter on it to chart that account alone, and Escape to go back. Click a legend entry to hide a series. Scroll or press + and - to zoom through time, drag to pan, double-click or 0 to reset, and the arrow keys step through periods. s saves the chart as SVG and p as PNG.

plugins.name: edit
plugins.summary: edit a loaded journal in a window
plugins.help: Opens a file in an editor window, with Ctrl/Cmd-S writing it back to disk. With no argument it edits the journal hledger is reading. Only files from an open folder can be written: everything else opens read-only, and the save says so. If the file changed on disk since it was opened, the save is refused rather than overwriting the change.
